items.title: George "Tex" Stephens Interview, 1996-01-10
items.q: the Cadillacs, Lil Willie John, and the Clovers

ctx.x: Okay. But he's sort of chastising they're doing that.

Look, I can understand that. Here's what I'm saying about the article. The people that he was referring to, what he wanted to get done, was for people to just sit there and not say anything and be cultured like. And remember now, you're dealing with a concert with Fats Domino and Ruth Brown singing the blues and the Cadillacs, Lil Willie John, and the Clovers, and I'm going to sit there and be quiet. Exactly. But see, what Hachu was trying to do on his own, Hachu was trying to get blacks to say, look, modify…
